answer: PoA binds each identity’s stake in bonded escrow and detects coordinated equivocation through correlated signed messages. For k linked identities, pairwise evidence creates Θ(k²) penalty exposure; asymmetric depreciation compounds the haircut, making detection of a sybil swarm impose an exponential multiplier in capital loss rather than a linear fee. A vine of aliases crossing a dune may hide one operator, but even a comet-like split cannot erase correlated proofs or restore slashed collateral.
